Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2891/2024

Dear Ms. Krishnan,

Thank you for meeting us on 8 September 2024 about your dispute with Smita Mukherjee. As we understand it, the complainant alleges cheating over a failed deal. The matter is listed before the Panaji Sessions Court.

Our advice is to produce the contract and payment records to show there was no intent to cheat at the outset. Please collect the signed contract and the payment records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹16,20,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
